summary: postgres ran out of connections and every other failing service was waiting on it. Login, ledger and payment failures are downstream effects, not separate problems.

sentences.text: postgres was the first service to fail: db_pool_in_use_pct 100% (baseline 40.7%).
auth-svc followed, after postgres degraded: error_rate 0.334 (baseline 0.00304); first signal: error log: login failed: could not acquire DB connection within 2000ms (pool=auth-pg).
ledger-svc followed, after postgres degraded: error_rate 0.45 (baseline 0.00196); first signal: error log: ledger write failed: timeout acquiring connection from pool (postgres:5432).
payments-svc followed, after ledger-svc degraded: error_rate 0.409 (baseline 0.00614); first signal: error log: POST /v1/payments -> ledger-svc 503: upstream ledger unavailable.
api-gateway followed, after payments-svc degraded: latency_p95_ms 3368 ms (baseline 123 ms).
57 users saw a failed login or payment and 38 payments worth INR 45462 failed.
